text:
alex: Quick sync after the proxy-throttle RFC. Two open questions: 1) where should short-term rejects happen (edge proxy vs admission), 2) what lightweight signal do we expose to clients so SDKs can fallback gracefully?

fiona: My vote: enforce fast rejections at edge for immediate QoS, but keep scoring and penalization in admission so we have model-cost context and longer-term signals. Edge should only surface a thin hint.

priya: agreed. from telemetry POV, edge can't know expected token cost. propose `quota_hint` enum: `green|amber|red`. No numeric cost exposed.

rahul: +1 to enums. For client behavior: green = proceed, amber = try smaller prompt or wait, red = fail-fast with Retry-After. SDKs can map these to backoff strategies.

alex: nice. we also need an async mirror of events to abuse-service for scoring. it should be sampled and tunable per-tenant. High-risk tenants => full mirror, normal => 0.5%, spikes => auto-bump sampling for 30s.

fiona: implement sampling policy server-side: sample_rate = base * risk_multiplier; risk_multiplier in {0.01, 1, 10}. Also emit a small fingerprint for dedup/merge (no PII).

priya: schema proposal for the edge hint in headers (short string): `x-rw-quota: amber` and optional `x-rw-hint-reason: latency` for debugging only. Do not include anything that reveals internal pricing.

rahul: fallback routing sequence idea: try same-model small-batching -> small-quantized variant -> degrade to `redwood-lite` -> reject. Need deterministic ordering in config so rollout tests are reproducible.

alex: operational gates for canary: p95 edge latency delta < 20ms, client error_rate delta < 0.3%, model-quality drift < 2% on eval-set. If any gate trips, rollback.

infra-bot: Canary deploy started: proxy-edge v5 -> canary slice 1% at 04:00 UTC :rocket:

fiona: action owners: priya owns header/schema, rahul owns fallback mapping + config, alex owns rollout ops and canary gates, infra-team to provide mirror topic.

priya: I'll post proto + example SDK mapping in #eng-devex by EOD. Also adding a tiny example:

```
# example client behavior pseudocode
if header == 'green': call()
elif header == 'amber': reduce_tokens(); call()
else: surface_error('rate_limited', retry_after)
```

rahul: worth noting: admission should ingest mirror stream to update tenant risk score and adapt admission soft-evict thresholds. Keep feedback loop >30s to avoid oscillation.

alex: Good. We'll treat this as RFC follow-up and merge schema v0.1. Meeting tomorrow 11:00 to review telemetry proto and canary dashboards. :thumbsup:
